answer_1.quote: Test-time scaling has emerged as a prominent strategy to enhance problem-solving capabilities during inference without model retraining. Generating long chain-of-thoughts or sampling multiple sequences have consistently showcased higher accuracy in many complex tasks like math, science and coding.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates reasoning chains, solutions to math and science problems, and code outputs as part of test-time scaling for language models.

answer_2.quote: We adopt throughput and acceptance length as our main evaluation metrics. Throughput measures the number of tokens generated per second, computed as the total number of generated tokens divided by the total drafting time. The acceptance length quantifies the average number of tokens generated per speculation step.
